Fast attacker preselection increments the index before storing into attack_indices[16], including the native unchecked sixteenth-index write. The assassin ranking performs one comparison pass before the mapping counter terminates its outer loop. Neither quirk is repaired.

The callback boost path saves the activating player as int8_t and sign-extends it on restore. All sixteen-word snapshots, byte maps, combination masks, forced-attacker rules, score/penalty comparisons, callback/EXE calls, band assignment and final legality retries retain the native behavior. mana_payment_native_2022.scope: Recover complete October 2022 charge_mana plus seven multi-color/resolving frontends as qualified entries in their original units. Restore typed arrays, pointer snapshots, EXE frames, Krrik/X/autotap/manual payment, stack capacity, tap trigger/sound, rollback and settlement and exact cleanup/return timing. Preserve the older engine body, its three existing fragment records and ten providers/frontends. Review five standard-library instantiations without counting new implementations; the C++ ID-conversion member remains a candidate. Downstream callers/gameplay migration remains separate work.

behavior: Preserve the public 32-entry stack guard and private worker, four-byte packed stack records, signed damage-target player, activation proxy allocation failure and hand bookkeeping, saved timestamp and original/backup IDs. Copy the full instance and extension, clear dying state and preserve the X-value handoff.

Recopy the instance and extension unless the parent has DONT_RECOPY; preserve parent/timestamp, damage-ID range, image word widths and signed damage target. Final activation resolves and dispatches its tap trigger in native order.

Spell finalization sets BEING_CAST, skips cast/copy events for SF_NOT_CAST, uses the extension Replicate byte, lets Storm override Replicate and Gravestorm override Storm, and loops the unsigned amount without clamping. Land/spell/this-spell/trigger ordering and post-trigger counter checks are exact.

Preserve sound order including Snow, clear BEING_CAST before the replacement trigger and resolution, retain native 0x80 enable bit and 0x01000e00 xtrigger independently from old header values, and retain all early returns, damage/regeneration calls, land count and fizzle cleanup.

Forced mana activation keeps the capacity guard but continues activation even if full. Newly tapped cards dispatch tap and tapped-for-ability events then a mandatory player tap trigger; already-tapped/untapped cards dispatch play-ability. The tap sound, resolution and reassessment remain unconditional on the successful path.

behavior: Preserve token exclusion for unearth, a second instance lookup through the extension flags, and raw SF2_X_SPELL mask results, including the native negative-player fallback.

The two sickness checks are identical. Add-state bulk mode selects creatures; remove-state bulk mode selects all permanents. Single-card modes skip the bulk filters. Unsupported untargettable modes do nothing.

Tap clears the mana-color marker only on the first tap and always returns zero. Untap reads a low-byte player flag and dispatches either to all cards or to one card; no-event untap only clears the bit.
Retain pointer-returning attack/activation queries, ascending slot scans and uncapped target iteration, graveyard printed types, creature-death sentinel 99 and get-card-data-before-in-play ordering.

Get-card-data falls back only for IID -1 to an unsigned 16-bit backup; mana-producing-land intentionally reads the current IID without that fallback. The 16 no-mana-cost IDs are decoded independently over the 16-bit domain and signed boundary cases.

int has_no_mana_cost_2022(int player, int card)
{
  int csvid = player == -1 ? cards_data[card].id : get_id(player, card);
  /* Native CSVIDs; independently decoded from the 2022 decision tree. */
  switch (csvid)
  {
    case 0x1dd5: /* Evermind */
    case 0x211d: /* Ancestral Vision */
    case 0x2181: /* Hypergenesis */
    case 0x2194: /* Living End */
    case 0x2197: /* Lotus Bloom */
    case 0x21c6: /* Restore Balance */
    case 0x221a: /* Wheel of Fate */
    case 0x4e75: /* Crashing Footfalls */
    case 0x4ebe: /* Mox Tantalite */
    case 0x59b6: /* Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar */
    case 0x5a01: /* Gaea's Will */
    case 0x5a0a: /* Glimpse of Tomorrow */
    case 0x5a1b: /* Inevitable Betrayal */
    case 0x5a4b: /* Profane Tutor */
    case 0x5a54: /* Resurgent Belief */
    case 0x5a72: /* Sol Talisman */
      return 1;
    default:
      return 0;
  }
}
